goal: Mark the latest ticket from Contoso as resolved.

reason: Need the ticket resolution procedure and company system URLs/naming conventions, plus customer alias info to identify Contoso.

objective: Mark the latest ticket from Contoso as resolved.
steps: Identify the latest ticket for Contoso: use lookup_customer with name "Contoso" to get the canonical customer name, then call find_latest_document(kind="ticket", customer=<canonical name>) to obtain the latest ticket number and source_file, and read_file(source_file) to confirm the ticket number inside the document.

Resolve the identified ticket in the helpdesk: goto "http://127.0.0.1:5001/tickets", snapshot the page, locate the link or row containing the ticket number from step 1 and click it to open the ticket detail page, then call submit_record with record_type="ticket_resolve", customer="Contoso Ltd", ticket_number=<ticket number>, and finally take a screenshot of the result.
